en.topic_title: Teen swimmer makes Games history as Thai, Chinese sprinters win gold

zh.topic_title: Teen swimmer makes Games history as Thai, Chinese sprinters win gold

en.topic_title: Teen swimmer makes Games history as Thai, Chinese sprinters win gold
en.topic_summary:
Towering teenager Zhang Zhanshuo became the first swimmer in history to win seven golds at a single Asian Games on Friday, as young Thai and Chinese sprinters powered to victory on the track in the 100m in record times.



Gold medallist China’s Zhang Zhanshuo celebrates after competing in the final of the men’s 400m freestyle swimming event during the 2026 Asian Games at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre in Tokyo on September 25, 2026. Photo: Yuichi Yamazaki/AFP.



China’s Zhang, 19,
